scope: Original tutorial and Stage 1 Seoul street/rooftop art; modular geometry supports later level assembly. No Stage 2 subway, detailed shop interiors, monsters, or level progression logic.

style_translation.description_ko: 주인공과 맞추어 큰 각면과 절제된 무광 색을 사용한다. 서울 상가·업무 빌딩·다세대 주택의 차이를 창 배열과 간판·발코니 실루엣으로 표현한다. 작은 때·스크래치·고해상도 PBR 질감은 생략한다.

authoring.method: Deterministic authored polygon meshes. Architectural dimensions and roof collisions are designed on a meter grid; detailed facade, canopy, frame, balcony, sill, utility and roof forms are modeled explicitly.
authoring.signature_props: Seven Meshy-generated props are normalized and palette-colored by UrbanPropBuilder.Build(); see root generation records for Sword, Staff, StreetLamp, StreetTree, VendingMachine, Bench, TrashBin, ACUnit and GatePylon.
authoring.authored_prop_detail: Twelve colored cans in vending display; five broad fan blades and grille on AC; faceted teal crystal and ivory center in gate frame; three solid faceted tree canopy clusters. Four reusable 0.237m potion bottle color variants for Health/Attack/Defense/Speed, opaque geometry with no glass rendering pass.

placement.architecture_pivot: center of footprint at ground level
placement.flat_module_pivot: center of footprint at walkable top Y=0
placement.note: Architectural ornaments and parapets are visual only and should not block the X gameplay lane. Building body colliders are solid. Move buildings behind the lane when used solely as a street background.

modules.features: Recessed shopfront glazing, framed double entry, teal sign and broad awning, rear pipes, low roof coping
Three window rows, muted lit windows, facade bands, twin teal vertical landmark panels, rear pipes
Five window rows, side windows, two balcony stacks, sill geometry and broad cornice
Wide flat open battle roof with low rear coping, eight large facade windows
Door, grille, vent chimney, overhanging roof slab
Dashed center stripe, edge stripe, drain channels and faceted manhole
Curb sections, large pavers, ochre tactile strip
Strip deck, twin structural beams, rear safety railing, hazard post caps
Twelve 0.25m rise metal/concrete treads, stringers, handrails and ochre tread noses
modules.collision: twelve tread box colliders; slope/step traversal behavior depends on the gameplay controller

modules.features: Thirteen rungs, two rails, wall brackets, extended grab handles
modules.collision: none; visual plus anchors, requires gameplay ladder trigger/controller

modules.features: Top/mid rails, five posts with bolted style base plates
Inset front door, five vent slots, handle and warning color plate
Tapered concrete tub, soil inset and three six-sided faceted shrub clusters
Tapered concrete shell, feet, lifting lugs and broad hazard markings
Ten-sided reservoir, reinforcing rings, tapered lid, four-leg support and outlet pipe
Thick frame, graphic sign panel, two feet and rear diagonal braces; original abstract graphics

optimization.geometry: Flat shaded per-face vertices; combined into one mesh per module or LOD, no procedural Update or runtime generation.
optimization.building_lod1: Reduces window inset details, sills, balcony and pipe geometry; retains building masses and readable window layout.
optimization.collision: Simple boxes only on designed walking surfaces; small props and decorative parapets do not carry mesh colliders.
optimization.batching: One vertex-color material shared across modules, GPU instancing enabled; editor static batching flags for architecture.
optimization.lighting: URP directional main light, shadows and fog. No baked directional shading in colors, no extra per-prop lights.

validation.source_review: Mesh face winding, coordinate convention, consistent prefab names and output paths reviewed.
validation.unity_build_and_visual_review: Performed by the integrating root task; see build reports generated alongside the kit.
validation.limitations: The source modules are modeled art assets with collision/anchors, not a completed navigable level or ladder/one-way platform gameplay system.
